title: Only 1% Can Answer These 3 Questions
hook: Just 1% of people score perfectly on this quiz.
script:
Just 1% of people score perfectly on this quiz. Think you're in that elite group? You'll need to be quick and confident! You’ve got precisely three seconds for each general knowledge question. No hesitation, just pure brain power. Let’s dive right in!

First up, question one: What is the capital city of Australia, the land down under? Think quick! Time starts now!
(3-second pause)
And the clock stops! The correct answer is Canberra. Were you sharp enough to get it right? One point for you if so!

Alright, time for question two: Which planet is famously known as the Red Planet, a celestial body of great mystery? Your three seconds begin… now!
(3-second pause)
Did you get it? That would be Mars! How are you doing so far? Two down, and just one challenge left.

Ready for the ultimate test? Final question: Who painted the iconic Mona Lisa, one of the most famous artworks ever created? Three seconds on the clock! Go!
(3-second pause)
The answer, of course, is the legendary Leonardo da Vinci. So, how many did you nail out of three?

It's tougher than it seems! Don't feel bad if you missed some; only a tiny 1% of people manage to get all three! So, did you beat the odds and score perfectly on this quiz?
